items.t: High-voltage battery fire risk, charge limit to 80% (recall)
items.job: High-voltage battery repair (recall 26V-698, remedy in development)
items.note: Audi was still developing the final fix as of late 2026; charge to 80% until then.

items.t: Onboard charger failure drains 12-volt battery and cuts power (recall)
Car shuts off while driving or won't start
items.job: Diagnose shutdown (12-volt battery test, recall and software check)
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix may be a free recall or software update or a new 12-volt battery, so the shop must test first. These cars are normally still under Audi's warranty. YourMechanic estimates about $95–$132 to diagnose a warning on the twin VW ID.4. A 12-volt battery replacement with coding runs about $370–$800 (Recharged).

items.t: Gear indicator may be wrong, car can roll away (recall)
Side curtain airbag can tear on door seal (recall)
items.job: Install protective cloth tape at front door pillars (recall 23V-189)

items.t: Rearview camera image blank or frozen (recall)
Charging fails or shows charging malfunction
items.job: Diagnose charging fault (charge port lock, onboard charger, software)
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on whether the charge port lock, the onboard charger or software is at fault. VW's bulletin for the twin ID.4 says the socket lock actuator can be replaced without the whole socket. A complete charge port assembly lists at about $690–$840. Warranty usually covers it on these model years. YourMechanic estimates about $95–$132 to diagnose a warning on the ID.4.

Diagnosis only: the fix may be the sound generator, its wiring or software, so the shop has to test first. Warranty usually covers it on 2024 models. YourMechanic estimates about $95–$132 to diagnose a warning on the twin VW ID.4.

items.t: Tires wear out early or lose tread chunks
items.job: Replace set of four tires, mount and balance
items.note: Ask about tire-maker warranty if tread separates at low mileage. An alignment adds about $200-$350.

items.t: Unexpected hard braking or parking brake engaging
items.job: Diagnose brake and parking brake control fault
items.note: Diagnosis only: dealers have not found one fixed cause, and software updates are the usual fix. Warranty usually covers it on these model years. YourMechanic estimates about $95–$132 for a parking brake inspection on the twin VW ID.4.

items.t: Keyless entry or remote lock stops working
items.job: Replace and code the 12-volt AGM battery
items.note: Have the battery tested first; it may be covered under warranty. Recharged puts parts at about $220–$450 and labor with coding at about $150–$350 ($370–$800 total).
